descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_step: Dispatches card-save operations and returns their progress or completion state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_begin: Prepares save filenames and the buffer checksum before opening a card file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_open: Opens the original file and records its file number.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_create: Creates a temporary save file and handles insufficient card space.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_status: Reads the status of the new or existing save file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_write_new: Writes the save buffer to the temporary card file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_write_old: Writes the save buffer to the existing card file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_close_new: Closes the temporary save file before replacing the original.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_delete_old: Deletes the original save file when it exists.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_rename: Renames the temporary save file to the original filename.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_close_old: Closes the original save file when it exists.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_overwrite_message: Handles the prompt to overwrite an existing save file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_done_message: Handles acknowledgment of the completed save prompt.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_ready_message: Handles confirmation to begin creating the save file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_save_failed_message: Handles acknowledgment of the failed save prompt.
